head: 6d76139029ca4162249667f0db65a73387a94cfe

commands.stdout: 6d76139029ca4162249667f0db65a73387a94cfe	2026-09-04T17:25:08+08:00	packaging: enable libc++ for Clang builds

packaging/tensorflow2.spec             | 16 ++++++++++++++++
 tensorflow/lite/kernels/elementwise.cc |  7 +++++--
 2 files changed, 21 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/packaging/tensorflow2.spec b/packaging/tensorflow2.spec
index b87d871fabd..dd2fb22ad9f 100644
--- a/packaging/tensorflow2.spec
+++ b/packaging/tensorflow2.spec
@@ -46,6 +46,14 @@ Source3000:     tensorflow2-aot.tar.gz
 %define USE_CLANG     "OFF"
 %endif
 
+%if %{USE_CLANG} == "ON"
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+%endif
+
 %if %{USE_CLANG} == "ON"
 %ifarch armv7l
 BuildRequires: python-accel-armv7l-cross-arm
@@ -73,6 +81,10 @@ BuildRequires: clang
 BuildRequires: cmake
 BuildRequires: ninja
 BuildRequires: python3
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires: libc++-devel
+BuildRequires: libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %description
 This is a standalone package of TensorFlow Lite.
@@ -164,6 +176,10 @@ pushd build
 CLANG_ASMFLAGS=" --target=%{host_triplet} "
 CLANG_CFLAGS=" --target=%{host_triplet} "
 CLANG_CXXFLAGS=" --target=%{host_triplet} "
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+CLANG_CXXFLAGS="${CLANG_CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
+export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
 
 export ASMFLAGS="${CLANG_ASMFLAGS}"
 export CFLAGS="${CLANG_CFLAGS}"

head_show_stat:
commit 6d76139029ca4162249667f0db65a73387a94cfe
Author:     He Fangyu <fangyu.he@samsung.com>
AuthorDate: Fri Sep 4 17:25:08 2026 +0800
Commit:     He Fangyu <fangyu.he@samsung.com>
CommitDate: Fri Sep 4 17:25:08 2026 +0800

    packaging: enable libc++ for Clang builds
    
    Select libc++ only when the active RPM toolchain is Clang, preserving GCC and configurations without toolchain macros. Disambiguate the std::abs overloads with explicit function pointer casts so the TensorFlow Lite elementwise kernels build with libc++.
    
    仅在 RPM 工具链为 Clang 时启用 libc++，保持 GCC 路径及未定义工具链宏的配置不变。通过显式函数指针转换消除 std::abs 重载歧义，使 TensorFlow Lite elementwise 内核可由 libc++ 构建。

 packaging/tensorflow2.spec             | 16 ++++++++++++++++
 tensorflow/lite/kernels/elementwise.cc |  7 +++++--
 2 files changed, 21 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
head_patch:
diff --git a/packaging/tensorflow2.spec b/packaging/tensorflow2.spec
index b87d871fabd..dd2fb22ad9f 100644
--- a/packaging/tensorflow2.spec
+++ b/packaging/tensorflow2.spec
@@ -46,6 +46,14 @@ Source3000:     tensorflow2-aot.tar.gz
 %define USE_CLANG     "OFF"
 %endif
 
+%if %{USE_CLANG} == "ON"
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+%endif
+
 %if %{USE_CLANG} == "ON"
 %ifarch armv7l
 BuildRequires: python-accel-armv7l-cross-arm
@@ -73,6 +81,10 @@ BuildRequires: clang
 BuildRequires: cmake
 BuildRequires: ninja
 BuildRequires: python3
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires: libc++-devel
+BuildRequires: libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %description
 This is a standalone package of TensorFlow Lite.
@@ -164,6 +176,10 @@ pushd build
 CLANG_ASMFLAGS=" --target=%{host_triplet} "
 CLANG_CFLAGS=" --target=%{host_triplet} "
 CLANG_CXXFLAGS=" --target=%{host_triplet} "
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+CLANG_CXXFLAGS="${CLANG_CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
+export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
 
 export ASMFLAGS="${CLANG_ASMFLAGS}"
 export CFLAGS="${CLANG_CFLAGS}"
diff --git a/tensorflow/lite/kernels/elementwise.cc b/tensorflow/lite/kernels/elementwise.cc
index 5552f125818..aabf8a07c7b 100644
--- a/tensorflow/lite/kernels/elementwise.cc
+++ b/tensorflow/lite/kernels/elementwise.cc
@@ -286,7 +286,8 @@ TfLiteStatus AbsEval(TfLiteContext* context, TfLiteNode* node) {
   const TfLiteType type = input->type;
   switch (type) {
     case kTfLiteFloat32:
-      return EvalImpl<float>(context, node, std::abs<float>, type);
+      return EvalImpl<float>(context, node,
+                             static_cast<float (*)(float)>(std::abs), type);
     case kTfLiteInt8:
       return AbsEvalQuantized<int8_t>(context, node, type);
     case kTfLiteInt16:
@@ -294,7 +295,9 @@ TfLiteStatus AbsEval(TfLiteContext* context, TfLiteNode* node) {
                  ? AbsInt16EvalImpl(context, node, type)
                  : AbsEvalQuantized<int16_t>(context, node, type);
     case kTfLiteInt32:
-      return EvalImpl<int32_t>(context, node, std::abs<int32_t>, type);
+      return EvalImpl<int32_t>(context, node,
+                               static_cast<int32_t (*)(int32_t)>(std::abs),
+                               type);
     default:
       TF_LITE_KERNEL_LOG(context, "Current data type %s is not supported.",
                          TfLiteTypeGetName(type));
